purpose: Post-hoc fixed-frame diagnostic of how much the original automatic box position differs from an explicit ground-truth-box oracle. Uses native SAM2.1 image predictor as an image-level diagnostic, not Lean video propagation.
scope: Sequences 8, 11, 20 and 23, five deterministic post-initial-prompt frames per sequence frozen by the existing split preflight. Inputs for seq23 use the fixed no-inset viewport. Sequence selection and prompt issue were already inspected; results are exploratory.
automatic_arm: For each selected image, reuse the sequence's single archived first automatic YOLO box without running the detector again, and decode one mask with the author's SAM2ImagePredictor. This is a frozen-box diagnostic, not an automatic video tracker or a proposed re-prompt schedule. It does not use any target labels.
oracle_arm: Only after every automatic prediction is frozen, compute a tight ground-truth box on labeled-present target images and decode the same image predictor with that explicit oracle box. Skip the oracle on labeled-empty frames and report that no box was available. Ground truth never enters the automatic branch. A GT box is a localization control, not an upper bound on achievable mask Dice.
engineering: Two separate label-free seq3 replays must reproduce fixed-box and deterministic synthetic comparison masks exactly, including source and weights hashes. Independently audit gates, then run two fresh processes for the automatic and oracle outputs and rescore saved outputs. Check image hash, source box, viewport and prompt mask provenance; score labels only after all predictions are saved.
constraints: No detector re-detection, confidence gate, added inference threshold, video propagation or trained new model. Restore seq23 predictions to original frame geometry. Report present-frame Dice, empty-frame false alarms, GT-box IoU, matched samples and model differences. Patient identity unverified and sequence 23 annotation may be incomplete.
